# test_sacf {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_sacf(data, d1, d2; alpha=0.05)
```
Perform the asymptotic two-sided test for spatial dependence at delay `(d1, d2)` based on the spatial autocorrelation function (SACF) and return a [`SACFTestResult`](SACFTestResult.qmd) with the test statistic, the asymptotic critical value, the p-value, and the reject decision.
 
  * `data::Matrix{<:Real}`: data matrix (spatial field).
  * `d1::Int`, `d2::Int`: row and column delays.
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.


:::
